$comment: Relic tiers and relics per league (docs/leagues.md), used by plugins/modes/LeagueRelics.plugin.js. Costs, names, effects and granted items are the Wiki's (Trailblazer_Reloaded_League/Relics, Raging_Echoes_League/Relics), and `requiresBank` is set only where the Wiki says the relic must be unlocked in a bank (every Trailblazer Reloaded item relic; Raging Echoes' Clue Compass, Bank Heist and Fairy's Flight, while its tier-1 tools are handed out anywhere, as the Leagues V tutorial's Animal Wrangler unlock in osrs-captures 227/00196 shows); the descriptions condense the Wiki's bullets in the cache's own style. `grants` names ItemIdentifiers; a relic whose item is no longer in this cache (Trailblazer Reloaded's Sage's greaves, Trailblazer tools, crystal of memories and guardian horn; Raging Echoes' Sage's greaves and guardian horn) grants nothing and says so in `_missing`. The client draws the catalog from structs and enums the server sends (structOverrides/enumOverrides, GamemodeContentStore): `virtualIdBase` + leagueType x 1000 is where this league's ids start, and `iconStructs` are the rev 241 cache's own relic structs (enums 5703-5710, the current league's), whose icon params (881-884, 1853, 1854) are reused per tier and slot since older leagues' icons are not in the cache. Params: 870 tier enum on the league struct, 877 cost, 878 relic enum and 2045 passive struct on a tier struct, 1020 passive text, 879 name, 880 description, 885 tier index, 1855 has-item on a relic struct.
_iconStructs: The cache's tier 7 enum (5709) holds only two relics, so its third slot borrows the first's icon.

interface._comment: league_relics (655) and the league side panel's relics button (656:44), as captured (227/00070, 227/00075): open as the main modal with if_setevents on clickzones 655:22 slots 0-23 and league_menu_frame 655:6 slots 10-20; a clickzone sets league_relic_last_viewed (tier x 3 + slot) and runs 3193 (the panel's components, the state the captures show, the relic struct, the tier's passive struct) and 3181; confirm_text 655:50 unlocks: the selection varbit, human_relic_unlock 8524, the league's unlock spotanim at height 92, the modal closed, sounds 4215/4211/4213/4212 at 8/44/80/104.
interface._modalSize: Script 2524 (-1, -3), which live ran before opening the interface (227/00196), sizes the modal.
interface._viewScriptState: The int argument of 3193 as sent in both captured slot clicks (227/00070 sub 9, 227/00075 sub 14), each on an affordable tier not yet chosen; what a locked or chosen tier gets was not captured.

effects._comment: The relics with effects here (SuperiorSorcerer / Berserker / UndyingRetribution.LeagueRelics.js), each gated on its league and on being chosen. Numbers are the Wiki's: no rsprox recording of Trailblazer Reloaded exists (the captures start at revision 223). Superior Sorcerer's splash reach (one tile around the primary target, like a burst) and Undying Retribution's graphic (the Retribution prayer's, 437) are ours; the Wiki gives neither.

undyingRetribution._recoilImmuneExceptions: Wiki: it still works on these though they are immune to recoil damage (Nex, the Hespori, Vorkath and every Wilderness boss).

6._comment: Leagues VI - Demonic Pacts is the league this cache (rev 241) carries: its tiers, costs, passives and relics are read from the league struct (6436, enum 2670) and sent as nothing; no relic hands out an item, since the cache does not say which do.

tiers.passive:
- Items from eligible sources will be 2x as common.

- Run energy is never drained whilst running.

- All clue scrolls will drop as stackable scroll boxes, limited to steps in unlocked regions.

relics.name: Endless Harvest
relics.description:
- Fishing, Woodcutting and Mining resources are doubled, with bonus XP.

- Gathered resources go to your bank, or your inventory when the bank is full.

relics.name: Production Prodigy
relics.description:
- Crafting, Smithing, Herblore, Fletching and Cooking are boosted by +12.

- Processing actions handle all items at once with full XP.

- 25% chance of an extra product, sent to your bank.

relics.name: Trickster
relics.description:
- Thieving, Agility, Hunter and Firemaking always succeed.

- Your coin pouch holds three times as much and you pickpocket again automatically, for doubled, noted loot.

- Box traps lure faster with double loot and XP, impling jars never break, and you can burn up to nine logs at once.

- Grants Sage's greaves, which give Agility XP while you run.
relics._missing: Sage's greaves are not in this cache.

tiers.passive:
- League XP multiplier increased from 5x to 8x.

- Minigame points received are boosted by 3x.

relics.name: Fairy's Flight
relics.description: - Grants a fairy mushroom that teleports you to any fairy ring, spirit tree or tool leprechaun in your unlocked regions.

relics.name: Globetrotter
relics.description: - Grants a globetrotter pendant that teleports you to every ornate jewellery box destination and nearly every spellbook teleport in your unlocked regions.

relics.name: Crystal of Memories
relics.description:
- Grants a crystal of memories that returns you to where you last teleported from.

- Its cooldown of 6 minutes falls by 1 minute per 300 total levels.
relics._missing: The crystal of memories is not in this cache.
relics._note: The Wiki lists the crystal as the tier 3 passive; the tier's two relics are Banker's Note and Fire Sale, so this third slot is left for it to keep three choices a tier.

tiers.passive: - Grants a crystal of memories, which teleports you back to the last place you teleported from.

relics.name: Banker's Note
relics.description: - Grants a banker's note: use an item on it to note or unnote it, or Activate it to convert a chosen quantity at once.

relics.name: Fire Sale
relics.description:
- Every coin shop with a standard interface sells for free, and can note what you buy.

- Shops no longer buy items for gold.

relics.name: Treasure Seeker
relics.description:
- NPCs that drop clues have a 1 in 15 chance to drop one, including impling jars.

- Clue scrolls have the fewest steps and reward caskets roll the most rewards.

tiers.passive:
- Items from eligible sources will be 3x as common.

- Slayer point rewards are 5x, with no minimum task streak.

relics.name: Archer's Embrace
relics.description:
- Ranged weapons attack twice as fast.

- Ranged accuracy is doubled, with a 10% chance of an extra projectile.

- 90% of ammunition is saved (98% with Ava's devices) and enchanted bolts proc twice as often.

relics.name: Brawler's Resolve

- Melee accuracy and all defences are increased by 50%, with a 10% chance to deal double damage.

- 90% of weapon charges are saved and you are immune to status effects from NPCs and players.

relics.name: Superior Sorcerer
relics.description:

- Magic accuracy is increased by 175% and magic damage by 20%.

- 90% of runes and powered staff charges are saved.

- In multicombat, magic attacks hit up to 5 surrounding targets for up to 25% of the damage dealt.

- Binding spells always hit unless the target is immune or already bound.

- Grants an arcane grimoire and a rune pouch.
